content_sections.heading: NTPC Recruitment 2026 Quick Summary
content_sections.text: Who is recruiting? NTPC Limited (A Govt. of India Enterprise), Advt. No. 13/26 Which posts? Deputy Manager (Civil Construction), Deputy Manager (Mechanical Erection), Deputy Manager (Electrical Erection), Assistant Manager (Operation/Maintenance) – Mechanical, Engineer (Electrical Erection), Assistant Officer (Safety) How many vacancies? 19 backlog vacancies (8 for SC and 11 for ST), as projected in the notification Who can apply? Indian nationals belonging to the SC/ST categories who meet the post-wise qualification, experience and age conditions Application start date: 29 September 2026 Last date to apply: 13 October 2026 (till 6:00 PM) Application mode: Online only, through careers.ntpc.co.in Job location: Any of the offices, stations, projects, JVs or subsidiaries of NTPC

content_sections.heading: NTPC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The online application window is short, so candidates should complete and submit the form well before the closing time. The notification does not mention dates for any test or interview.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Vacancy 2026 Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The notification lists six posts, labelled A to F, with reservation only for SC and ST candidates. The total number of projected vacancies may increase or decrease as per organizational requirement, at the discretion of NTPC management. Reservation for PwBD candidates applies as per Govt. guidelines for Posts A to E. Post F, Assistant Officer (Safety), is not identified for PwBD candidates. The identified types of disabilities, as listed in the notification, are given below.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility depends on the post applied for. Only Indian nationals can apply, and all qualifications must be full-time from universities or institutions recognized and approved in India. Age, experience and qualification are all computed as on the last date of receipt of online applications, which is 13 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates currently working in a Government organization or Public Sector Undertaking have extra conditions, in addition to the general experience requirement above. Posts A, B and C (Deputy Manager): Out of the 8 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training/trainee period, if any), candidates must have a minimum of 2 years of experience in the pay scale of Rs. 60,000 – 1,80,000 or above (IDA pay scale of E3 grade or above of NTPC, effective from 01.01.2017) or an equivalent scale. Candidates must also provide an NOC (No Objection Certificate) from their employer while applying. Post D (Assistant Manager, Operation/Maintenance – Mechanical): Out of the 5 years of post-qualification executive experience (excluding training/trainee period, if any), candidates must have a minimum of 2 years of experience in the pay scale of Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000 or above (IDA pay scale of E2 grade or above of NTPC, effective from 01.01.2017) or an equivalent scale. An NOC from the employer is required while applying. Posts E and F (Engineer, Assistant Officer): Candidates must provide an NOC from their employer while applying.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The notification gives an upper age limit for each post and no minimum age. Where a vacancy is identified for PwBD candidates, the upper age limit is relaxed by 10 years. Age relaxation for Ex-Servicemen is as per Govt. guidelines. The notification does not state a separate age relaxation for SC/ST candidates. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is not specified in the provided notification. Candidates should check the online application portal, careers.ntpc.co.in, for any fee details before submitting the form.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: The notification gives the level and IDA pay scale for each post rather than a fixed monthly salary.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not give a fixed selection schedule. It states that, to restrict the number of candidates for further selection, management reserves the right to conduct a multi-stage selection process. This may include application shortlisting/screening (based on qualification, percentage of marks, years of post-qualification or site experience, and similar factors), a written/computer-based test, a personal interview, or a combination of these. Management may also raise the minimum eligibility standards as required. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not give a candidate the right to be shortlisted, called for a written test or interview, or considered further in the selection process. Before joining, candidates must undergo a medical examination by the NTPC Medical Board/Officer, whose decision is final and binding. No relaxation in the prescribed health standards is allowed. Detailed medical norms are available on careers.ntpc.co.in, and applicants are advised to read them before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NTPC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only online applications are accepted, and no other mode of application will be considered. Visit the official application portal, careers.ntpc.co.in . Read the full text of Advt. No. 13/26 and agree to all the conditions while applying for the post. Fill in the online application form with correct details. A valid email ID is required. Upload all the required documents. Applications with incomplete or insufficient documents are liable to be rejected or not considered for further process. Submit the application on or before 13 October 2026 (till 6:00 PM). Download the application slip generated by the system with the unique application number and keep a copy for future reference. No document needs to be sent by post.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Recruitment 2026 Apply Online: Documents to Upload
content_sections.text: Candidates should upload all documents while applying. The name and date of birth should appear consistently across all documents. Class X passing certificate/marksheet, PAN Card and Aadhar Card (name and DOB should appear in conformity on all documents). B.E./B.Tech. degree (Final/Provisional) certificate. Safety Diploma (Final/Provisional) certificate (only for Post F). Consolidated marksheet/transcript or all semester marksheets clearly indicating the aggregate percentage of marks in all semesters. Marks conversion formula from the university/institute for conversion of CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI etc. into percentage (%). Caste/Disability certificate (for SC/ST/PwBD candidates) as applicable. Disability certificate in the latest prescribed central Govt. format, generated online through the Swavalamban/UDID portal (clearly indicating the type and percentage of disability), in line with the identified disability for the posts. Experience documents for each organization/company, placed together in chronological order from the first to the last/current company. The set should include, but is not limited to, the Experience/Service certificate (as per NTPC prescribed sample format), Offer of appointment/Appointment letter/Offer Letter with Confirmation/Absorption Letter/Order on completion of training (if any), Joining Order/Letter, Role Assignment orders, Promotion orders, Transfer orders, Organization charts, Form-16 and similar documents to corroborate the work area/department/section, and 2 pay slips per year for each organization. NOC (No Objection Certificate) from the current employer, for candidates currently working in Govt/Public Sector Undertakings. Pay scale circular/matrix to verify service for the required number of years in the required pay scale, for candidates currently working in Govt/Public Sector Undertakings.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by the National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC) for various engineering and executive positions across India.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NTPC Advt. No. 13/26?
faq.answer: A total of 13 vacancies have been announced for positions including Deputy Manager, Assistant Manager, Engineer, and Assistant Officer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for NTPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 13 October 2026. Candidates should apply well in advance to avoid last-minute rush.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech degree in the relevant engineering discipline from a recognized university along with post-qualification executive experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for Deputy Manager posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Deputy Manager positions will receive a salary scale ranging from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 200,000 (E4 Grade).

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for NTPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee details are mentioned in the official notification. Candidates can check the official website for any updates regarding fee payments.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Assistant Officer (Safety)?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the Assistant Officer (Safety) post is 30 years. Age relaxations apply as per government guidelines.

faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official careers website of NTPC at careers.ntpc.co.in and completing the online registration process.

faq.answer: The selection process for NTPC recruitment typically comprises a written test and/or personal interview depending on the post requirements.
